name: reset_between_polls_epoch_overlap
comment: durable reset regression: a reader previously reached epoch=0/seq=1, then is between polls while the producer resets to epoch=1 with detail=gen2 and rebuilds a snapshot+delta whose seq values overlap at 0..1. A later read with the old epoch=0/seq=1 must receive state=reset with the retained producer reason/detail and the fresh epoch=1 snapshot+tail; sequence equality must never hide the reset. Re-reading at the returned epoch=1/seq=1 is caught up and would_block.
